chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
A man's family are his captives, and the most beloved of servants to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is the one who treats his captives in the best manner.

key_terms.أَحَبُّ الْعِبَادِ: the most beloved servants in the sight of Allah
key_terms.أُسَرَاؤُهُ: those under his control and responsibility, likened here to captives
key_terms.عِيَالُ: dependents or family members under a person's care

ai.seo_question: How does Islam describe a man's responsibility toward his family?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person bears a serious moral responsibility toward his family, who are described as being under his charge and dependence. It emphasizes that excellence in conduct toward one's household is among the most beloved deeds to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
